definitions: to fill a container or space tightly with something
to fill the body of a cooked bird or vegetable with a mixture of other foods
to push something into a small space, often quickly and carelessly
to eat a lot of food
examples: She stuffed her pockets with sweets.
We stuffed the turkey with sage and onion.
He stuffed the letter into an envelope.
I've been stuffing myself with chocolate all day.
